title: The regions of Leonida
summary: The game is set in Leonida, a fictional US state. Rockstar's own guide to the state names six areas to explore, with Vice City as the main city.

facts.label: Areas named by Rockstar
facts.value: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga

title: Meet the main characters
summary: You play as two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Rockstar has published short bios of them and the people around them. Open the details for that background.

details.summary: Background from Rockstar's official character bios, in brief.
steps: Jason Duval grew up around con artists, did a stint in the Army, and now does work for drug runners in the Keys.
Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father. Fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; she's just out and has a plan.
Cal Hampton: Jason's friend, a homebody who listens in on Coast Guard radio and believes every conspiracy online.
Brian Heder: a veteran smuggler in the Keys who lets Jason live in one of his properties in return for help with local jobs.
Boobie Ike: a Vice City figure who turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest.
Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy): a rap duo signed to Only Raw Records, chasing a second hit.
Raul Bautista: an experienced bank robber who recruits people willing to take big risks.

title: GTA+ perks: sell vehicles for more, pay less in shops
summary: If you have a GTA+ membership on console, Rockstar lists optional perks in the story: 10% more money when you sell a vehicle you own, 10% off at many shops, and free or upgraded ways to get around. Skip this if you don't subscribe; nothing in the game requires it.
steps: GTA+ is a paid monthly membership bought through the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store. It renews automatically until you cancel.
Keep the membership active and play online to claim the perks.
Sell vehicles you own rather than abandoning them: members get a 10% higher sale price.
Buy weapons, clothes, haircuts, tattoos and vehicle mods at participating shops to get the 10% discount.

facts.label: Shop discount
facts.value: 10% at select businesses: weapons and clothes shops, hairdressers, tattooists, vehicle mod shops and more

facts.label: Getting around
facts.value: Scooter Bros Premium vehicle care, RydeMe rideshare premium, free scooter and bike rentals, Leonida metro benefits

title: '90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy (GTA+)
summary: A widebody sports car that GTA+ members on console can claim from Chapter 3, along with a garage in the Crosstown District.
steps: Have an active GTA+ membership on console.
Play until Chapter 3: Rockstar says the car can be claimed from then.
Claim the car and the Crosstown District garage. Rockstar doesn't say exactly where to claim it in-game; we'll add that once we've confirmed it.

facts.label: Comes with
facts.value: A garage in the Crosstown District
